name: RICH_MANS_TOMB
canonical: a rich man's rock-hewn burial tomb cut into a hillside, a square dark entrance with a great round disc-shaped sealing stone rolled in its channel beside it. A first-century well-made Judean garden tomb — NOT a modern headstone or graveyard, NOT a built mausoleum, NOT an earthen grave
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
